units.source_text: 七段刚坐下又站起来走了。

en.t: The seventh dan had just sat down when he stood up again and walked away.

units.source_text: 这也是他的一种战斗准备，就如同名人的呼吸变粗一样。

en.t: This too was a kind of battle preparation for him, just like the Master's breathing growing heavy.

units.source_text: 名人那狭窄的溜肩膀不停地起伏，深深打动了我，

en.t: The Master's narrow, sloping shoulders kept rising and falling, and this moved me deeply,

units.source_text: 我仿佛偷看到了灵感到来的秘密，

en.t: as if I had secretly glimpsed the mystery of inspiration arriving,

units.source_text: 它不是痛苦，也不是畏惧，

en.t: it was neither suffering nor fear,

units.source_text: 连名人本人也不知道，别人更无从知道了。

en.t: even the Master himself did not know it, and others had even less way of knowing.
